description:
Build a checkout for one or more courses

Turn a course into a purchase. Give one or more product ids and this creates a real cart on the store and returns a checkout link that completes the sale. Free to call; the course price is paid at checkout. Use agent_search_courses to find the product id first. Multiple ids go in one cart, so a recommended set can be bought together in a single transaction.

### Responses:

**200**: Successful Response (Success Response)
Content-Type: application/json
name: agent_buy_course
